name: hlhb (RSI50 cross + EMA5/10 cross + ADX>25)
author: unknown (not stated in file)
entry_long: RSI crosses above 50 AND EMA5 crosses above EMA10 AND ADX>25 AND volume>0
exit: RSI crosses below 50 AND EMA5 crosses below EMA10 AND ADX>25
implementation_notes: The two crosses must coincide on the same bar - very rare. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
